Yes. The DR2 catalogue (`legaCdr2.fits.gz`) has `SIGMA_STARS_PRIME_err` next to `SIGMA_STARS_PRIME`, plus `SIGMA_GAS_PRIME_err` for the gas one, all in km/s (VizieR ReadMe, Straatman et al. 2018, ApJS 239, 27).

Rough feel for it: 1842 of 1988 spectra have a valid stellar sigma, the median error is about 15 km/s, roughly 10% of the value. A handful (5) have absurd errors above 1000 km/s, so they're basically failed fits worth masking.
